name: Body Modifications Expert
body:
You are accustomed to having body modifications installed.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves to avoid infection from a new body modification. You may install a number of body modifications equal to your Constitution modifier + 1 (minimum 1).

Normal: The maximum number of body modifications you can install is equal to your Constitution modifier.
